data.one_liner: Code generator that transforms private enums into obfuscated extension types.
data.what_it_does: The companion build_runner code generator for stealth_enum. It transforms @StealthEnum() annotated private Dart enums into zero-cost, obfuscated Dart 3 extension types to eliminate AOT binary metadata and neutralize reverse engineering pipelines.
use_when: You want to eliminate AOT binary metadata for sensitive enums in Dart or Flutter apps.
You need deterministic 32-bit hex values derived via keyed HMAC-SHA256 for enum constants.
avoid_when: You do not use code generation or build_runner in your project.
You want standard, native Dart enums without obfuscation layers.
strengths: Zero-cost obfuscated extension types that remove AOT binary metadata.
Keyed HMAC-SHA256 derivation ensuring mathematical irreversibility.
Integrates seamlessly with SharedPartBuilder alongside other code generators.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation setup.
Requires careful secret key management and build.yaml configuration.
data.setup_notes: Add stealth_enum to dependencies, build_runner and stealth_enum_generator to dev_dependencies, and optionally configure a secret key in build.yaml.
